decisions.reason: The complete same-message MODIFY already records the aggregate ticket-count rule and registration of randomly assigned no-referral tickets.
The complete same-message MODIFY already records one accounted commission per primary mint and registration of randomly assigned no-referral commissions.
The existing same-message MODIFY already requires the NFT Small Block ticket counter to include randomly assigned no-referral tickets.
The source concerns registration and accounting of random commissions, while this Requirement already assigns no-referral commissions randomly to existing NFT holders.
The source addresses randomly assigned tickets for no-referral mints, not issuance to a referrer when a valid code is used.
The source establishes an accounting rule but does not request FAQ copy changes; the existing no-referral allocation copy remains valid.
Random allocation of no-referral tickets and their registration do not change the VRF winner-selection method or eligible draw population.
The ticket-registration rule does not change which referral codes are valid or the associated validation feedback.
The source changes ticket accounting for no-referral primary mints, not the Small Block prize amount, trigger, funding, eligibility window, or reset behavior.
Requiring random commissions and tickets to be registered does not alter the mint price or the existing per-mint revenue allocation.
The source provides an accounting rule and does not request any landing-page wording or presentation change.
The source concerns random no-referral commission accounting and does not change commission behavior for successful mints using valid referral codes.
